html:
📡 HTTP 状态码查询

完整的HTTP状态码参考手册

常用状态码

200 OK
201 Created
301 Moved
302 Found
400 Bad Request
401 Unauthorized
403 Forbidden
404 Not Found
500 Server Error
502 Bad Gateway

没有找到匹配的状态码

let currentCategory = "all";
let searchQuery = "";
// Theme
window.toggleTheme = function () {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const currentTheme = html.getAttribute("data-theme");
    const newTheme = currentTheme === "light" ? "dark" : "light";
    html.setAttribute("data-theme", newTheme);
    localStorage.setItem("theme", newTheme);
};
function loadTheme() {
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || "dark";
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", savedTheme);
}
// Get category class
function getCategoryClass(code) {
    if (code >= 100 && code < 200)
        return "status-1xx";
    if (code >= 200 && code < 300)
        return "status-2xx";
    if (code >= 300 && code < 400)
        return "status-3xx";
    if (code >= 400 && code < 500)
        return "status-4xx";
    if (code >= 500 && code < 600)
        return "status-5xx";
    return "";
}
// Get category name
function getCategoryName(code) {
    if (code >= 100 && code < 200)
        return "信息响应";
    if (code >= 200 && code < 300)
        return "成功";
    if (code >= 300 && code < 400)
        return "重定向";
    if (code >= 400 && code < 500)
        return "客户端错误";
    if (code >= 500 && code < 600)
        return "服务器错误";
    return "";
}
// Filter functions
window.filterCodes = function () {
    searchQuery = document.getElementById("searchInput").value.toLowerCase();
    renderStatusCodes();
};
window.filterByCategory = function (category) {
    currentCategory = category;
    // Update active tab
    document.querySelectorAll(".category-tab").forEach((tab) => {
        tab.classList.toggle("active", tab.dataset.category === category);
    });
    renderStatusCodes();
};
window.jumpToCode = function (code) {
    document.getElementById("searchInput").value = code.toString();
    searchQuery = code.toString();
    currentCategory = "all";
    document.querySelectorAll(".category-tab").forEach((tab) => {
        tab.classList.toggle("active", tab.dataset.category === "all");
    });
    renderStatusCodes();
    // Expand the card
    setTimeout(() => {
        const card = document.querySelector(`[data-code="${code}"]`);
        if (card) {
            card.classList.add("expanded");
            card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        }
    }, 100);
};
// Toggle card expansion
window.toggleCard = function (card) {
    card.classList.toggle("expanded");
};
// Render status codes
function renderStatusCodes() {
    const grid = document.getElementById("statusGrid");
    const noResults = document.getElementById("noResults");
    // Filter codes
    let filteredCodes = statusCodes.filter((status) => {
        // Category filter
        if (currentCategory !== "all") {
            const catPrefix = currentCategory.replace("xx", "");
            if (!status.code.toString().startsWith(catPrefix)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        // Search filter
        if (searchQuery) {
            const searchLower = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
            return (status.code.toString().includes(searchQuery) ||
                status.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
                status.nameCn.includes(searchQuery) ||
                status.brief.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
                (status.tags && status.tags.some((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower))));
        }
        return true;
    });
    // Update counts
    updateCounts();
    if (filteredCodes.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = "";
        noResults.style.display = "block";
        return;
    }
    noResults.style.display = "none";
    grid.innerHTML = filteredCodes
        .map((status) => {
        const categoryClass = getCategoryClass(status.code);
        const categoryName = getCategoryName(status.code);
        return `
                    <div class="status-card ${categoryClass}" data-code="${status.code}" onclick="toggleCard(this)">
                        <div class="status-card-header">
                            <span class="status-code">${status.code}</span>
                            <div class="status-info">
                                <div class="status-name">${status.name}</div>
                                <div class="status-brief">${status.nameCn} - ${status.brief}</div>
                            </div>
                            <span class="status-category-badge">${categoryName}</span>
                            <svg class="expand-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <div class="status-card-body">
                            <div class="detail-section">
                                <h4>详细说明</h4>
                                <p>${status.description}</p>
                            </div>
                            ${status.usage
            ? `
                            <div class="detail-section">
                                <h4>使用场景</h4>
                                <p>${status.usage}</p>
                            </div>
                            `
            : ""}
                            ${status.tags
            ? `
                            <div class="detail-section">
                                <h4>标签</h4>
                                <div class="tags">
                                    ${status.tags.map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${tag}</span>`).join("")}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            `
            : ""}
                            ${status.example
            ? `
                            <div class="detail-section">
                                <h4>示例</h4>
                                <div class="code-block"><pre>${escapeHtml(status.example)}</pre></div>
                            </div>
                            `
            : ""}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
    })
        .join("");
}
function updateCounts() {
    document.getElementById("countAll").textContent = statusCodes.length;
    document.getElementById("count1xx").textContent = statusCodes.filter((s) => s.code >= 100 && s.code < 200).length;
    document.getElementById("count2xx").textContent = statusCodes.filter((s) => s.code >= 200 && s.code < 300).length;
    document.getElementById("count3xx").textContent = statusCodes.filter((s) => s.code >= 300 && s.code < 400).length;
    document.getElementById("count4xx").textContent = statusCodes.filter((s) => s.code >= 400 && s.code < 500).length;
    document.getElementById("count5xx").textContent = statusCodes.filter((s) => s.code >= 500 && s.code < 600).length;
}
window.escapeHtml = function (text) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = text;
    return div.innerHTML;
};
// Initialize
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    loadTheme();
    renderStatusCodes();
});
